title: Booze Fighters take over Hollister, stealing the headlines

tellings.quote: what happened was a bunch of World War veterans who were in a motorcycle gang called the Booze Fighters, which is a play on Foo Fighters, took over uh Hollister, California for a day and had a drunken party downtown.

plain: In 1947 a gang of World War veterans on motorcycles, who called themselves the Booze Fighters as a play on Foo Fighters, the wartime name for strange lights pilots saw, took over the town of Hollister, California for a day and threw a drunken party downtown. A guest named John Brandenburg tells this on the show, passing on what he was told, as an event that grabbed the newspaper headlines that year and pushed other stories aside.
